/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
import gzip, collections, itertools
sets={}
with gzip.open('inputs/mystery.peak.set.q1.bed.gz','rt') as f:
    for line in f:
        c,s,e,n=line.split()
        sets.setdefault(n,set()).add((c,int(s),int(e)))
labels=sorted(sets)
print('counts',{s:len(sets[s]) for s in labels})
# exact overlaps and reciprocal
for a,b in itertools.combinations(labels,2):
    A=sets[a];B=sets[b]
    inter=len(A&B)
    jac=inter/len(A|B)
    print(a,b,'inter',inter,'jaccard',round(jac,3),'prec',round(inter/len(A),3),'rec',round(inter/len(B),3))
# union exact
U=set().union(*sets.values()); print('union exact',len(U),'total',sum(map(len,sets.values())))
PY"
